cases.sql: SELECT k FROM inputs GROUP BY k ORDER BY MAX(f), k
cases.purpose: Issue query. Hidden string maximum, ascending with default null placement.

cases.sql: SELECT k FROM inputs GROUP BY k ORDER BY MAX(f) DESC NULLS FIRST, k DESC NULLS LAST
cases.purpose: Hidden string maximum with explicit null placement.

cases.sql: SELECT k FROM inputs GROUP BY k ORDER BY MAX(f) ASC NULLS LAST, k
cases.purpose: Hidden string maximum with explicit null placement in ascending order.

cases.sql: SELECT k FROM inputs GROUP BY k ORDER BY LENGTH(MAX(f)) ASC NULLS LAST, k
cases.purpose: Scalar length of a hidden aggregate.

cases.sql: SELECT k FROM inputs GROUP BY k ORDER BY COALESCE(MAX(f), 'x'), k
cases.purpose: Scalar coalesce moves the all-null group into a distinct sort position.

cases.sql: SELECT k FROM inputs GROUP BY k ORDER BY COUNT(n) DESC, k NULLS LAST
cases.purpose: Hidden count, including the all-null group and tied counts.

cases.sql: SELECT k FROM inputs GROUP BY k ORDER BY SUM(n) ASC NULLS LAST, k
cases.purpose: Hidden sum with negative, positive and null group totals.

cases.sql: SELECT k FROM inputs GROUP BY k ORDER BY COUNT(n) DESC, SUM(n) DESC NULLS LAST, k
cases.purpose: Two independent hidden aggregates ordered in sequence.

cases.sql: SELECT k FROM inputs GROUP BY k HAVING SUM(n) >= 4 ORDER BY LENGTH(MAX(f)), k
cases.purpose: Grouped HAVING and a different hidden aggregate in the sort key.

cases.sql: SELECT k FROM inputs GROUP BY k HAVING COUNT(n) > 0 ORDER BY COUNT(n) DESC, k NULLS LAST
cases.purpose: The same hidden aggregate is used in HAVING and ORDER BY.

cases.sql: SELECT k AS group_key FROM inputs GROUP BY k ORDER BY MAX(f), group_key
cases.purpose: Hidden aggregate paired with a selected group key alias.

cases.sql: SELECT k, MAX(f) AS max_f FROM inputs GROUP BY k ORDER BY MAX(f), k
cases.purpose: Visible aggregate as a control for the direct issue query.

cases.sql: SELECT k, MAX(f) AS max_f FROM inputs GROUP BY k ORDER BY LENGTH(max_f) ASC NULLS LAST, k
cases.purpose: Scalar order over a visible aggregate alias.

cases.sql: SELECT k FROM empty_inputs GROUP BY k ORDER BY MAX(f), k
cases.purpose: Empty grouped input keeps the selected result schema.

cases.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS row_count FROM inputs ORDER BY MAX(f)
cases.purpose: Global aggregate with a hidden sort key and a visible BIGINT count.

cases.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS row_count FROM inputs HAVING COUNT(*) > 0 ORDER BY LENGTH(MAX(f))
cases.purpose: Global HAVING with a scalar over a hidden aggregate.

cases.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS row_count FROM empty_inputs ORDER BY COALESCE(MAX(f), 'x')
cases.purpose: Empty global aggregate still returns a count row.

cases.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS row_count FROM empty_inputs HAVING COUNT(*) > 0 ORDER BY MAX(f)
cases.purpose: HAVING filters the global result on empty input.

cases.sql: SELECT DISTINCT k, MAX(f) AS max_f FROM inputs GROUP BY k ORDER BY LENGTH(max_f) DESC NULLS LAST, k NULLS LAST
cases.purpose: DISTINCT with a selected aggregate alias in the sort expression.

cases.sql: SELECT DISTINCT k FROM (SELECT k FROM inputs GROUP BY k ORDER BY MAX(f), k LIMIT 3) AS grouped ORDER BY k NULLS LAST
cases.purpose: DISTINCT applies to rows chosen by an inner hidden aggregate sort.

cases.sql: SELECT DISTINCT k FROM inputs GROUP BY k ORDER BY MAX(f), k
cases.purpose: Probe whether Spark resolves a hidden sort aggregate through DISTINCT.

cases.sql: SELECT DISTINCT COUNT(*) AS row_count FROM inputs ORDER BY MAX(f)
cases.purpose: Probe whether Spark resolves a global hidden sort aggregate through DISTINCT.

cases.sql: SELECT k FROM inputs ORDER BY MAX(f), k
cases.purpose: Probe an ungrouped raw column with an aggregate sort key.

cases.sql: SELECT k AS f FROM inputs GROUP BY k ORDER BY MAX(f), f
cases.purpose: A selected alias shadows a source column inside a hidden aggregate.

cases.sql: SELECT k, MAX(f) AS picked FROM inputs GROUP BY k ORDER BY COALESCE(MIN(f), picked), k
cases.purpose: A scalar sort key combines a hidden aggregate with a selected aggregate alias.

cases.sql: SELECT k FROM inputs GROUP BY k HAVING k IS NOT NULL ORDER BY MAX(f), k
cases.purpose: Grouped HAVING uses only the grouping key; ORDER BY uses a hidden aggregate.

cases.sql: SELECT 1 AS r FROM inputs HAVING TRUE ORDER BY MAX(f)
cases.purpose: HAVING establishes global aggregation without a selected aggregate.

cases.sql: SELECT k FROM inputs GROUP BY k ORDER BY MAX(k) DESC NULLS LAST, k
SELECT k AS group_key FROM inputs GROUP BY k ORDER BY MAX(k) DESC NULLS LAST, group_key
SELECT k, GROUPING_ID(k) AS g FROM inputs GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ((k), ()) ORDER BY GROUPING_ID(k), MAX(f), k
SELECT k, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY k NULLS LAST) AS rn FROM inputs GROUP BY k ORDER BY MAX(f), k
SELECT k FROM inputs GROUP BY k ORDER BY MAX(f), 1 LIMIT 3 OFFSET 1
